summary: The open AI model repository ecosystem centers on Hugging Face as the dominant hub, which crossed 3 million public models in August 2026 and is adding roughly a million per year, though downloads are highly concentrated (the top 200 models account for ~half of all downloads). Alongside the repository layer, a growing set of developer-facing inference platforms—Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, SiliconFlow, and others—compete to serve open-weight models via simple APIs or local runtimes with usage-based pricing. These are distinct from enterprise cloud aggregators and managed MLOps platforms, focusing instead on accessible model hosting, fast inference, and developer experience.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central hub for hosting, sharing, and discovering open-source AI models, datasets, and demos, plus serverless and dedicated inference endpoints.
platforms.model_count: ~3 million+ public models (3,011,630 as of mid-August 2026, growing ~1M/year)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public repos and limited inference; Pro at ~$9/month; usage-based Inference Endpoints (pay per compute hour); Enterprise plans available
features: Largest open model and dataset repository with Git-based version control
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Spaces for hosting ML demos (Gradio/Streamlit)
Transformers, Diffusers, and Datasets libraries
Model cards, download stats, and community collaboration tools
Integration with major inference providers via Inference Providers routing
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers who want to find, share, fine-tune, or deploy open models across the broadest possible catalog.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A tool for running open large language models locally on personal machines with a simple CLI and API, emphasizing privacy and offline use.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models/variants (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Mistral, DeepSeek, Phi, etc.) in its library
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; runs locally with no usage fees (hardware cost only)
features: One-command local model download and run
Cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows)
Built-in REST API and OpenAI-compatible endpoint
Quantized GGUF models for consumer hardware
Modelfile customization for prompts and parameters
Growing ecosystem integrations and GUI front-ends
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run and prototype with LLMs locally without cloud dependencies.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform to run and share open-source models via API, including image, video, audio, and language models, with easy deployment of custom models.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models (tens of thousands of versions)
platforms.pricing: Usage-based, pay-per-second of GPU/CPU compute; no subscription required
features: Run models with a single API call
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Strong support for image/video/audio generation (Flux, Stable Diffusion, etc.)
Automatic scaling and cold-start handling
Public model sharing and discovery
Fine-tuning support for select models
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups who want to quickly integrate multimodal open models into apps without managing infrastructure.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance cloud inference and training platform for open-source LLMs and multimodal models, offering fast APIs and dedicated GPU clusters.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-token pricing for inference; per-hour GPU pricing for dedicated endpoints and training clusters
features: OpenAI-compatible inference API
Optimized serverless and dedicated endpoints
Fine-tuning and custom model training
GPU clusters for large-scale training (Together GPU Clusters)
Support for the latest open frontier models
Fast inference with proprietary optimization stack
platforms.best_for: Companies and developers building production applications on open LLMs who need scalable, low-latency inference and training.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A fast, cost-efficient inference platform for open-source and fine-tuned LLMs and multimodal models, optimized for production throughput and latency.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models plus custom fine-tuned deployments
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-token pricing; dedicated deployments priced per GPU-hour; fine-tuning fees
features: FireAttention-optimized high-speed inference engine
OpenAI-compatible API
LoRA and full fine-tuning support
On-demand and dedicated GPU deployments
Function calling and structured output support
Multimodal and embedding model serving
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises needing low-latency, high-throughput open-model inference at production scale.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A developer-facing inference platform (strong in the Chinese and global markets) serving open LLMs, image, audio, and video models via unified APIs.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kolors, FLUX, and others)
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-token/per-image pricing with competitive rates and free credits for popular models
features: OpenAI-compatible inference API
Strong support for leading Chinese open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM)
Text, image, audio, and video generation endpoints
Serverless and dedicated deployment options
Fast inference optimization
Fine-tuning support for select models
platforms.best_for: Developers seeking affordable access to Chinese and global open models, especially in Asia-Pacific markets.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform powered by custom LPU (Language Processing Unit) hardware, serving open-weight LLMs at very high speeds.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek, Mixtral, Whisper)
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-token pricing; competitive rates emphasizing speed per dollar
features: Proprietary LPU hardware for record-breaking token throughput
OpenAI-compatible API (GroqCloud)
Very low latency ideal for real-time applications
Support for popular open LLMs and speech models
Function calling and structured outputs
platforms.best_for: Developers building latency-sensitive, real-time AI applications on open models.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway/aggregator routing requests across many open and proprietary model providers through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models from dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per-token with transparent provider pricing and a small routing margin; no subscription
features: Single API for many model providers
Automatic fallback and provider routing by price/latency
OpenAI-compatible interface
Access to both open-weight and proprietary models
Usage analytics and spend controls
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access to a wide range of models through one API.
